subtitles.src: Welcome everyone. Today we will discuss how neural networks learn from data.
I will keep each example concrete and tie it back to a product decision.
Backpropagation is the chain rule applied repeatedly so we can train deep models.
Scale changes what a model can represent, but it does not replace a clear objective.
When the objective is wrong, a larger model simply makes the same mistake faster.
Thank you for listening, and I hope this framing is useful next week.
